title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Bank Service
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A financial institution established primarily to accept deposits from the public, safeguard money, and grant loans with the aim of making a profit is called a
questions.explain: A **commercial bank** is a profit-oriented financial institution that performs the primary functions of accepting deposits from the general public and providing loans to individuals and businesses.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All the following are standard services provided by a commercial bank to its customers EXCEPT
options: printing and issuing the national currency
questions.explain: Accepting deposits, granting loans, and safekeeping valuables are basic commercial bank services. **Printing and issuing the national currency** is the exclusive statutory function of the Central Bank.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which specific bank service allows a trusted businessman operating a current account to withdraw more money than the actual balance in their account up to an agreed limit?
questions.explain: An **overdraft** is a short-term credit facility exclusively available to current account holders, allowing them to draw more funds than they have in their account, paying interest only on the overdrawn amount.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a commercial bank buys a bill of exchange from a customer before its maturity date at a price slightly lower than its face value, it is providing the service of
options: acting as an executor or trustee
questions.explain: **Discounting bills of exchange** is a bank service where the bank pays the holder of a bill immediately (minus a small discount fee) before the bill is officially due for payment.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A customer who wants to deposit money for a specific long period to earn a higher interest rate and cannot withdraw it before maturity without a penalty should use a
questions.explain: A **fixed deposit account** (or time deposit) locks the customer's money in the bank for an agreed period, and in return, the bank pays a higher interest rate than other account types.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Customers often submit their wills, jewelry, and land property deeds to the commercial bank. Which bank service are they utilizing?
questions.explain: Banks provide highly secure vaults for the **safekeeping of valuables** (also known as safe custody), protecting customers' important documents and precious items from fire and theft.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The ethical banking rule that strictly forbids bank employees from disclosing a customer's account balance, transaction history, or personal details to unauthorized third parties is known as
questions.explain: **Confidentiality** (or bank secrecy) is a fundamental ethical banking principle ensuring that a customer's financial affairs are kept totally private and secure from unauthorized persons.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An unethical practice where a bank manager uses their position and power to irregularly approve loans for themselves or their family members without requiring adequate collateral is termed
questions.explain: **Insider abuse** occurs when bank officials act unethically by manipulating internal policies, such as granting unsecured loans to themselves, relatives, or associated businesses.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following actions by a commercial bank constitutes a major ethical violation against its customers?
options: Demanding a valid identity card before opening a new account
Deducting hidden and unexplained charges from customers' accounts
Refusing to grant a loan to a customer who has no collateral
Closing the banking hall exactly at the stipulated official time
questions.explain: **Deducting hidden and unexplained charges** violates the ethical principle of transparency and fair play. Banks must clearly communicate all fees and charges to customers.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Criminals sometimes try to use commercial bank services to hide the origins of cash obtained from illegal activities so it appears legitimate. This unethical and illegal activity is called
questions.explain: **Money laundering** is the process of passing illegally acquired money through legitimate bank systems to disguise its criminal origins and make it look clean.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a bank cashier discovers a shortage in the cash register at the end of the day and secretly alters the record books to balance the account, the cashier lacks the banking ethic of
questions.explain: Falsifying or altering financial records to cover up a mistake or theft represents a complete lack of **truthfulness, accountability, and probity** (honesty) in banking.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The modern bank service that utilizes computers and the internet to enable customers to check their balances and transfer funds without physically visiting a bank branch is called
questions.explain: **E-banking** (or electronic banking) encompasses online banking, mobile apps, ATMs, and POS terminals, allowing customers to perform banking services remotely and efficiently.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
